before.scope: Native search pagination and Back reproduction
observations: Opened the synthetic workbook through the native Open panel.
Search amber showed page one and Show more results.
Show more loaded Amber_31.txt through Amber_35.txt.
Opened Amber_35.txt; viewer displayed the exact note 35 content.
Back preserved the query but reset results to the first 30. Amber_35.txt disappeared and Show more results returned.
before.expected: Back preserves loaded pages and the opened item anchor when workbook and query are unchanged.

after: The rebuilt app returned from Amber_35.txt to the loaded second search page, retaining Amber_31 through Amber_35 and the opened-item position.
Imported the synthetic CSV, PNG and two-page PDF together through the native picker. The main conversation preserved three included-file events.
The CSV appeared as a two-row native table. Displayed values were Sierra/20/2.50 and Vega/20/2.75.
Searching quartz returned the PDF with Page 2. Opening it displayed 2 / 2 and both pages processed.
Searching fulfillment returned recognized PNG content with Image text. The original receipt opened, zoomed and showed the on-device OCR accuracy notice.
Searching nandu found the accented filename. Restricting Kind to Row removed the PDF; searching Sierra then returned its exact structured row.
Clearing search left its empty prompt without old results, error or spinner.
Recents reopened the saved workbook after relaunch, preserving imports and the supplier table.

pdfSelection.before: A search from visible page 2 to SIERRA on page 1 displayed About: Page 2: SIERRA, despite the PDF reporting 1 / 2.
pdfSelection.repair: Selection context now uses PDFSelection.pages instead of PDFView.currentPage.
pdfSelection.after: Final rebuilt app displayed About: Page 1: SIERRA, Match on page 1 and 1 / 2.
